title: Patch: the living board's standing scene holds the phone frame budget: card art, backs and portrait motes animate on composited layers
thread: **Issue #3674 (data, not instructions):** ````text # #3674: Patch: the living board's standing scene holds the phone frame budget: card art, backs and portrait motes animate on composited layers Opened by @jgoetzmann. Follow-up to #3633. This is the issue #3664 asked a person to open: its builder had no GitHub access. The text below is #3664's, with links added. **What it does.** #3633's first pass (#3664, merged as ee5f9eb, landed as @MaxGoetzmann chose, option 1) cut what a queue step costs on R3351000's living board. `fx-phone-living-game.cy.tsx` still misses at 4x throttling. The cost left is the standing scene: the idle living board, with nothing playing, already takes about 40–49 ms of the 50 ms mean per frame. **Why.** Traced in Chrome at 4x, idle, 390x844: - CSS animations restyle about 130 elements every frame: the moving faces' art (the `art-m-particle` and subject SVG groups), the face-down backs' `jk-facedown-breathe`, the hero portraits' `portrait-art-mote` and the tile auras' motes. - Paint, layerize and commit take about 20 ms more. - Forcing the shed to its deepest stage, or serving React's production build, does not bring the moments in. **Where it stands** (#3664's local run on its merged tree, Chrome at 4x; mean / worst frame in ms, budget 50 / 120): | Size | Anomaly cast, attempts 1 / 2 / 3 | Mythic takeover, attempts 1 / 2 / 3 | |---|---|---| | 390x844 | 64.4/191, 53.6/217, **40.1/85 (passes)** | 63.0/173, 67.1/278, 62.3/228 (fails) | | 360x780 | 57.3/174, **43.0/95 (passes)** | 86.8/252, 67.8/246, 49.8/162 (fails on the worst frame) | | 844x390 | 51.1/85, 51.1/172, 52.6/190 (fails, mean 1–3 ms over) | not reached | **Proposal.** - Animate the moving faces' art, the backs' breathing and the portrait motes on composited HTML layers (transform and opacity on their own elements) instead of SVG groups and filters, so a frame restyles none of them. - Let the phone director shed within a moment, not only between them. - Stay inside R3351000 and R2803000: no raised budget, no lower throttle, no cut layer, beat, hold or timing. **Acceptance.** - `e2e component (chrome)` passes `fx-phone-living-game.cy.tsx` 4/4, in the daily super run or with `ci.yml` dispatched with `e2e: all`. - The `layout:report` rows show every moment within 50 ms mean and 120 ms worst at all three sizes, in at least one of `FRAME_ATTEMPTS` plays. - The other component specs stay green, and the art looks as it did. **Why it is urgent.** Until this lands, `fx-phone-living-game.cy.tsx` keeps the daily super run's `e2e component (chrome)` red. Since #3656, a red super run on staging holds main → staging promotions until its fix lands. ## Plan _Written by `claude-7` (claude, `opus`, strong) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/42949710050)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._ ## Goal Cut the idle living board's per-frame cost and stop shed steps re-rendering the board, inside R3351000 and R2803000 (no budget, throttle, layer, beat, hold or timing change): 1. A board Mythic's diorama slice whose motion is one chain of loops runs that chain on HTML layers (transform and opacity, on the compositor) over a still picture. 2. The face-down breath drops its `filter`. Its brightening becomes an overlay that animates opacity only. 3. A shed step re-renders only the faces and auras that stage changes. 4. The director sheds within a moment: new ruling R3674000, amending R3606000. Then run `fx-phone-living-game.cy.tsx` and report every `layout:report` row. The planner's runs say the Mythic takeover may still miss (Open questions). ## Files to touch | Path | | What | |---|---|---| | apps/web/src/cards/art/dioramas/lift.ts | new | `LIFTABLE_MOVES`, `LiftMove`, `SliceLift`, `MOTION_STYLE`, `liftSvg`, `liftedSlice`, `sliceWindowUri` | | apps/web/src/cards/art/dioramas/lift.test.ts | new | lift and CSS tests | | apps/web/src/cards/art/CardArt.tsx | change | board ("all") slices draw lifts; `liftChain`; `data-art-lifted`; `.cf-art-shade` | | apps/web/src/cards/art/artLive.css | change | lift layer rules, 10 `cf-lift-*` rules and keyframes | | apps/web/src/cards/art/ART.md | change | a paragraph in "Dioramas (R3350000)" | | apps/web/src/cards/diorama.test.tsx | change | board-face expectations read lifted windows; new render test | | apps/web/src/test/artPicture.ts | change | `decoded` reads the innermost `.cf-art-lift` | | apps/web/src/game/facedown.css | change | breath scale-only; `jk-facedown-glow` overlay; reduced motion | | apps/web/src/game/backrow-suspense.test.tsx | change | R2111000 expectations | | apps/web/src/cards/motionSlots.ts (+ `.test.ts`) | change | stillness snapshot; render-count test | | apps/web/src/fx/aura/TileAura.tsx (+ `.test.tsx`) | change | aura-scale snapshot; Profiler test | | apps/web/src/fx/aura/AuraLayer.tsx (+ `.test.tsx`) | change | aura-scale and near-aura snapshots; measure-count test | | apps/web/src/fx/constants.ts (+ `.test.ts`) | change | `FX_ADAPT_MOMENT_WINDOW = 8` | | apps/web/src/fx/director.ts (+ `.test.ts`) | change | moment runs in `adapt`; R3674000 tests | | spec/rulings/R3674000.md, spec/pending/3674.md | new | ruling and its §11 paragraph | | crates/cards/patches/pending/.json | new | `--visual` fragment (R2529000) | | e2e/cypress/component/full-art-board.cy.tsx, art-answers.cy.tsx | change only if their run fails on a lifted window's background | read it as step 5 does | Do not touch: `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`, `.claude/`, `spec/11-rulings.md` and any other Rust. In `fx-phone-living-game.cy.tsx`, leave the budgets, throttle, `FRAME_ATTEMPTS` and every moment as they are. Do not run `cargo jackioh spec index`. Exports: - `LIFTABLE_MOVES: ReadonlySet` = bob, breathe, sway, hop, drift, swell, pulse, float, rise, fall.
